name: Best of Both
tagline: The balanced main plan, always together: one short Hakone–Fuji car trip from Kawasaki to Mishima, one Osaka hotel for 5 nights, and 5 nights in Hokkaido, with only 5 hotels.
summary: 3 nights in Shinjuku with a full anime day and a Girls Band Cry day in Kawasaki, where Pegasis picks up a car for Daikoku, the Turnpike and Fuji. One Fuji-view villa night, then the car goes back at Mishima and a direct Kodama takes you to one Osaka hotel for Nara, Suzuka, Kyoto, Kobe and Liberty Walk. A JAL flight to Hokkaido: 3 nights in Kutchan for skiing (Pegasis teaches Aoki) and the Rusutsu drift course, 2 nights in Sapporo with the Asahiyama penguins. You do everything together, every meal has a named place, and every train and bus has its departure time. Pegasis brings his own winter clothes; ski wear is rented at Hirafu.

who.pegasis: In: 24 of 25 WANTs. Daikoku (you drive, no guide) + Tatsumi, Turnpike, Taikanzan, Otome Pass, Gotemba outlets (plain shopping, 45 min), TMG view, Isetan depachika, airport bus instead of N'EX, Omoide/Golden Gai, Radio Kaikan, Maidreamin, Ikebukuro goods route, Nakano, SHELTER with a live show, Nara hill fire, Suzuka EV kart and the Tokaido car road (as Hakone–Fuji by car + Suzuka + Nagoya), Niseko Grand Hirafu, Rusutsu drift (30-min self-drive course at 15:00), Asahiyama penguins, GARAKU, Moiwa, Daruma. Out: Onuma (2 h south of Niseko, a whole extra day). Your maybes in: Chureito, Lake Kawaguchi, Shibuya Sky, Kobe beef, Osu, the Kawasaki GBC walk. Because you travel together, you now also join some short stops you marked not interested: Suga stairs (15 min), Nissan Crossing (20 min), Enoshima (1 h), Fuji Motorsports Museum (1 h), Toyota museum (1 h 20), Fushimi Inari and Kinkakuji (a calm morning, not at dawn). Nijo Market is out (no split on the last day).
who.aoki: In: about 43 of 49 WANTs. Omoide/Golden Gai, Suga stairs, Tokyo Station dome and Hachiko (GBC Tokyo), Nissan Crossing, TMG, Radio Kaikan, ZEST, Nakano and used goods, Ikebukuro, Shimokita and a SHELTER live show, Shibuya Sky before 15:00 + Nintendo/Pokémon, the Kawasaki GBC stamp walk, Daikoku + Tatsumi, Enoshima + Slam Dunk crossing, Hakone as Tokyo-3, Fuji Motorsports Museum, Lake Kawaguchi, Hanz villa, Yuru Camp Motosu, Nara fire, Suzuka, Toyota museum, Fushimi Inari + Kinkakuji (not at dawn, so Pegasis can join), Sabbat places (Kyoto, Osaka, Kobe), Namba food, Den Den Town, Liberty Walk, Donki coupon, two Niseko ski days on the beginner area (Pegasis teaches you, no paid lesson), Rusutsu drift (back seat), Moiwa, Daruma. You also join Pegasis's Taikanzan and Gotemba outlets (short stops you marked not interested). Out: Yokohama Chinatown and Cup Noodles (no time on the Kawasaki day; Kobe's Nankinmachi instead), GBC Yako stamps, Fujiten ski (Niseko instead), the paid maid-café tour (two maid cafés instead), Cape Kamui (path closed in winter), Aokana/Goto (off route), Toyota Kaikan (closed Sundays). Uji is skipped because you marked it not interested.

cost.transport: ≈ ¥126,000 per person (Tokyo car 2 days: Toyota ≈ ¥19,000 + studless ¥4,400 + one-way ¥8,800 + tolls, fuel, parking ≈ ¥16,000, split; Kodama Mishima → Shin-Osaka ¥12,300; Kansai, Suzuka and Nagoya trains ≈ ¥20,000 + Suzuka taxis ≈ ¥2,000; JAL ¥16,330; Hokkaido 4WD 3 days + fuel ≈ ¥60,000 split (not checked); Asahikawa JR ¥10,880 + zoo buses ¥1,340; airport buses and trains (TYO-NRT ¥1,500, Itami bus ¥730); suitcase courier ≈ ¥3,000)
cost.hotels: ≈ ¥148,000 per person (Super Hotel 3 nights ¥25,700; Hanz with breakfast ≈ ¥15,000, dinner extra; Dormy Inn PREMIUM Namba 5 nights ≈ ¥50,000 not checked; STAY RESORT NISEKO 3 nights ¥81,360 per room = ≈ ¥40,700 (Rakuten, Sep 26, 2026); Route Inn 2 nights ≈ ¥16,500)
cost.activities: ≈ ¥115,000 Pegasis / ¥95,000 Aoki (ski rental 2 days ≈ ¥38,600 each with the 10% early code; lift tickets peak season 1 day ¥11,800 × 2 each; no ski lesson; Rusutsu: Pegasis Introduction Course ¥31,000, Aoki back seat ¥10,000; Shibuya Sky, SHELTER, maid cafés, Suzuka, Fuji Motorsports Museum ¥1,800, Toyota museum ¥1,000, Kinkakuji ¥500, Port Tower ¥1,200, Moiwa, zoo — the museums and temples now for both)
cost.total: ≈ ¥389,000 Pegasis / ¥369,000 Aoki, plus meals about ¥4,000–6,000 a day (≈ ¥75,000; every meal is in the day plans), excl. international flights. Pegasis also buys a suitcase for the way home (≈ ¥5,000–15,000) and pays a return bag fee if the fare has none. If Aoki takes a pro ride-along instead of the back seat: +¥7,000.

flights: Pegasis: WestJet Toronto 09:35 Mon Jan 18 → Calgary → Narita 16:30 Tue Jan 19; home Air Canada New Chitose 19:35 Tue Feb 2 → Vancouver → Toronto 19:57 (one multi-city ticket about CA$1,247; the AC leg alone was CA$721 on Google Flights, Sep 26, 2026). He brings his own winter clothes and buys a suitcase in Tokyo for the way home: pick a fare that includes 1 checked bag on the way home, or add it (estimate CA$75–100 if not included).

Aoki: Air China Shanghai Pudong 09:40 → Narita 13:40 Tue Jan 19 (about CA$376; Google Flights showed 'price unavailable' on Sep 26, 2026: if it cannot be booked, take China Southern 09:15 → 13:15, CA$354, or Juneyao 08:25 → 12:00; the day plan still works); home Spring Airlines New Chitose 13:50 → Shanghai Pudong 17:00 Tue Feb 2 (CA$750 on Google Flights, Sep 26, 2026; Korean Air via Seoul from CA$612). Day 15 = visa day 15.
Osaka → Hokkaido: JAL (J-Air) Itami 10:50 → New Chitose 12:35, Thu Jan 28, ¥16,330 with a 20 kg bag (Google Flights, Sep 26, 2026). Cheaper: JAL 07:35 → 09:25, ¥13,030.

bookFirst.what: Toyota Rent a Car, both cars: Kawasaki Shinkawabashi → Mishima Shinkansen-guchi, Jan 21 17:45 – Jan 23 10:05, compact, STUDLESS TYRES + ETC; and New Chitose Poplar → Sapporo-ekimae, 4WD (studless standard), Jan 28 13:50 – Jan 31
bookFirst.why: book now (by Sep 30, 2026): Toyota takes bookings 6 months ahead, and Kanagawa has only a few studless-tyre cars. Phone Kawasaki Shinkawabashi (044-211-0100) to get the studless car confirmed in writing; if they have none, ask another Toyota Rent-Lease Yokohama shop near Kawasaki Station.

bookFirst.what: STAY RESORT NISEKO (Kutchan), twin, non-smoking, Jan 28–31 (3 nights, room only)
bookFirst.why: book now (by Sep 30, 2026): only 9 rooms were left on Rakuten on Sep 26 (¥81,360 for 2 people). Hotel Three M has only smoking twins left.

bookFirst.what: Dormy Inn PREMIUM Namba, twin, Jan 23–28 (5 nights)
bookFirst.why: book now (by early October 2026) on the official site: the hotel has only 12 twins + 7 compact twins, and Sat Jan 23 is the Nara festival night. Write the real price into the plan.

bookFirst.what: Hanz Outdoor Resort villa, Fri Jan 22, half board
bookFirst.why: book by Oct 5, 2026, because only 2 villas were left on Sep 25 and it is refundable. When you book, tell them you arrive about 17:10 (some sites say last check-in 17:00).

bookFirst.what: Flights: Aoki's return over Chinese New Year and Pegasis's multi-city ticket (with 1 bag home)
bookFirst.why: book by Oct 15, 2026, because Feb 2 fares to Shanghai are already high and rise further.

bookFirst.what: Grand Hirafu .Base ski rental, full 2-day set for both, Jan 29–30
bookFirst.why: book by Oct 31, 2026 with code TGHRental109 (10% off, shown on the Grand Hirafu rentals page): saves ≈ ¥4,300 each. No ski lesson: Pegasis teaches Aoki.

bookFirst.what: Rusutsu snow drift, Sat Jan 30, 15:00 Introduction Course (Pegasis drives 30 min, ¥31,000; Aoki in the back seat ¥10,000)
bookFirst.why: email activity@rusutsu.co.jp now (by Oct 15, 2026) to ask if a 1-year licence + IDP is accepted; book only after the answer, by mid-November. A 10% cancel fee applies from the moment you book, and 15:00 is the only slot for this course.

bookFirst.what: Suzuka entry + Circuit Challenger EV kart (Asoview) for Sun Jan 24, at about 12:30
bookFirst.why: buy on Dec 1, 2026 at 00:00 JST, when the January times come out: the kart runs only about 12:00–13:15.

bookFirst.what: Pegasis: International Driving Permit (1949 Geneva type) from CAA
bookFirst.why: get it by Dec 15, 2026, because both car rentals and the drift course need it.

bookFirst.what: SHELTER live ticket for Wed Jan 20, and Shibuya Sky web ticket for Thu Jan 21 morning
bookFirst.why: SHELTER: buy when the January list comes out (December 2026). Shibuya Sky: sales open 2 weeks ahead, on Jan 7, 2027 at 00:00 JST.

bookFirst.what: Steakland Kobe lunch, Tue Jan 26 12:00, 2 people
bookFirst.why: book about 2 weeks before by phone (078-332-2900) or EPARK; the official site warns about a fake copy site.

places.ja: 成田国際空港
places.blurb: Both of you land in Terminal 1 on Tue Jan 19. Aoki lands first and waits; you take the airport bus together.

info.label: Pegasis
info.value: At immigration ask for a paper landing stamp (not the face-scan gate): the car shop must see it

tips: Register in Visit Japan Web before the flight for the immigration QR code.
Pegasis: ask for a paper entry stamp at the gate. Rental companies may want to see it.

places.ja: スーパーホテル新宿歌舞伎町
places.blurb: Your Tokyo base for 3 nights: a small economy twin with a free breakfast buffet and a carbonated-spring public bath. Omoide Yokocho, Golden Gai and Isetan are all within 10 minutes on foot.

info.label: Price
info.value: Twin with breakfast about ¥16,000–17,800 a night (Jalan, seen Sep 25, 2026)

info.label: Laundry
info.value: Coin laundry in the hotel (renewed 2025, per the hotel Instagram)

info.label: Parking
info.value: None: use a coin car park nearby on Jan 21 (about ¥2,000–3,000 overnight)

tips: The front desk sends suitcases by Yamato TA-Q-BIN (宅急便): used on Jan 21.
Big carbonated bath in the hotel: optional, nobody has to use it.

places.ja: 須賀神社（男坂）
places.blurb: The red-railed stairs from the last scene of Your Name. Early morning is quiet.
tips: Stay on one side of the stairs: people live here.

places.ja: 東京駅 丸の内南口ドーム
places.blurb: The brick dome where Nina arrives in Tokyo in Girls Band Cry episode 1. The airport bus stops next to the station.
tips: Look up: the dome ceiling is the shot from the anime.

places.ja: NISSAN CROSSING（ニッサン クロッシング）
places.blurb: Nissan's free showroom on the main Ginza crossing, with new and special cars and a café. A 30-minute stop.
tips: Check the site for the cars on show in January 2027.

places.ja: 伊勢丹 新宿店
places.blurb: The basement food hall of Isetan. From about 19:00 sushi, bento and deli food get 20–50% stickers before the 20:00 close.
tips: Brand counters do not always cut prices; look at the bento and sushi counters.

places.ja: 思い出横丁
places.blurb: A narrow alley of tiny yakitori bars beside the Shinjuku tracks. Each bar has 6 to 12 seats.
tips: Golden Gai (新宿ゴールデン街) is 8 min east: one drink there before Don Quijote.
Banpaiya standing bar: drinks from about ¥290.

places.ja: ドン・キホーテ 新宿歌舞伎町店
places.blurb: Open all night, 3 min from the hotel. Pegasis buys the suitcase for the way home here; Aoki can use the tourist coupon.

info.label: Tax-free
info.value: From ¥5,000 before tax, passport; tourist coupon on the Donki app

info.label: Small items
info.value: Heat packs カイロ 10 pcs ≈ ¥400–700 · shoe spikes 靴用滑り止め ≈ ¥1,000–2,000 · plug adapter ≈ ¥500

tips: Plugs: Japan is 100 V, type A (two flat pins). Canadian 2-pin plugs fit; 3-pin plugs and Chinese type I plugs need an adapter.
Buy a 60–70 L suitcase with 4 wheels: it must hold everything Pegasis buys until Feb 2.

places.ja: 東京都庁 展望室
places.blurb: A free observation deck 202 m up in the city hall tower. On a clear winter morning you see Mt Fuji.
tips: Go in the morning: Fuji is clearest before noon in winter.

places.ja: 秋葉原ラジオ会館
places.blurb: 10 floors of figures, trading cards, model kits and anime goods, opposite Akihabara station.

info.label: Station
info.value: 秋葉原駅 電気街口

tips: Akihabara ZEST (Oshi no Ko, 秋葉原ZEST) is 3 min north: look from outside.
Do not follow street touts for maid cafés.

places.ja: めいどりーみん 秋葉原本店
places.blurb: The big maid café chain, with a small stage show. First-timers get a 'passport'. No table charge.

info.label: Cost
info.value: ¥880 per hour + food; about ¥2,000–2,500 with lunch

tips: Book on the official site.
Walk past street touts: go only to real shops.

places.en: Ikebukuro anime goods route (Animate main store, Surugaya, K-BOOKS)
places.ja: アニメイト池袋本店・駿河屋・K-BOOKS
places.blurb: Chinese fans now call Ikebukuro the best place for anime goods: the 9-floor Animate main store, then Surugaya and Lashinbang for used goods and the row of K-BOOKS shops.
tips: Route: Animate → Stellaworth (2F, across the road) → Surugaya 1F + Lashinbang 3F → K-BOOKS buildings toward Sunshine City.
Eat lunch in the Sunshine 60-dori side streets.

places.ja: 中野ブロードウェイ
places.blurb: A 1960s shopping building. Floors 2 to 4 are full of used figures, manga and toys, with many Mandarake shops.
tips: Go after 13:00: many small shops open late.

places.ja: 下北沢（ぼっち・ざ・ろっく！聖地）
places.blurb: Bocchi the Rock's home area: the station, Honda Theater, Donguri Hiroba park (ep 4) and the Senrogai empty lot (ep 5), plus used-clothes and record shops.
tips: You arrive after dark: the shopping streets are lit and busy until about 20:00.
Do not photograph private houses.

places.ja: 下北沢SHELTER
places.blurb: The real live house behind STARRY in Bocchi the Rock. You go inside for an evening show, like Kessoku Band's first live.
tips: The Jan 20, 2027 line-up appears about December 2026: buy the ticket then (pick up at 7-Eleven or FamilyMart).
Standing only. Enter by the number on your ticket.
When you buy the ticket, note the OPEN time and end the Shimokitazawa walk 15 min before it.

places.ja: SHIBUYA SKY（渋谷スカイ）
places.blurb: An open-air roof deck 230 m above the Shibuya Scramble. A morning slot is the cheap web price and has the clearest Fuji view.

info.label: Sale
info.value: Web tickets open about 2 weeks ahead (about Jan 7)

info.label: Nearby
info.value: Shibuya PARCO 6F: Nintendo TOKYO and Pokémon Center, 8 min walk

tips: The roof closes in strong wind or rain. Check in the morning.
After: Hachiko statue and Spain-zaka (Girls Band Cry ep 3) are 5 min on foot.

places.ja: ラゾーナ川崎プラザ ルーファ広場
places.blurb: Girls Band Cry: the open square where the band plays on the street. Start the GBC stamp tour here.
tips: Island Mura Guitars closed on Sep 23, 2026: check the new stamp list in January 2027.

places.ja: 多摩川見晴らし公園
places.blurb: Girls Band Cry: the riverside park by the Tama River where Nina and Momoka talk. Wide sky, trains crossing the bridge.

info.label: From station
info.value: Kawasaki West Exit, 1 km (15 min walk)

tips: Windy and cold by the river: bring gloves.

places.ja: 丸福珈琲店 川崎アゼリア店
places.blurb: Girls Band Cry café scene, under the East Exit plaza (another scene spot). Hotcakes and strong coffee to warm up.

info.label: Above it
info.value: Kawasaki Station East Exit plaza (Girls Band Cry stamp)

tips: The East Exit plaza (川崎駅東口 駅前広場) stamp is right above you.

places.en: Toyota Rent a Car Kawasaki Shinkawabashi
places.ja: トヨタレンタカー 川崎新川橋店
places.blurb: The car pickup: a real Toyota shop on Shinkawa-dori, 5–8 min on foot from Kawasaki Station east side, that allows one-way returns outside the prefecture. The shop inside MUZA Kawasaki (west exit) does NOT allow one-way returns.

info.label: Address
info.value: 1-1-3 Kaizuka, Kawasaki-ku (on Route 15 side, near Kawasaki Police Station)

info.label: Rent
info.value: Thu Jan 21 17:45 → Sat Jan 23 10:05 at Mishima

info.label: Price (C1 compact, e.g. Yaris/Passo)
info.value: 24 h ¥10,340 + next 24 h ¥8,690 = ≈ ¥19,000 · studless tyres ¥2,200 per 24 h · one-way to Mishima ¥8,800 (Toyota one-way calculator) · damage waiver extra

info.label: Licence
info.value: Toyota: valid licence + 1949 Geneva IDP + passport with landing stamp; no minimum years stated. Aoki: licence accepted in Japan

tips: Book NOW on rent.toyota.co.jp (bookings open 6 months ahead) and tick studless tyres (スタッドレスタイヤ, ¥2,200 per 24 h, few cars) and ETC; get the studless car confirmed in writing.
Both drivers show licence + passport; extra driver is free.

places.ja: 大黒PA
places.blurb: The famous JDM car meet in a loop of expressway ramps. Pegasis drives in himself, no guide.

info.label: Access
info.value: By car only (Shuto Wangan / Bayshore route)

info.label: Closure risk
info.value: Police now close it on some weekdays too (about 3 nights a week in April 2026); Fri–Sat highest

tips: At 18:00 check X and the Shutoko closure site; if the PA is closed, drive straight to Tatsumi PA (35–40 min from Daikoku).
Food court and konbini inside: dinner here.

places.ja: 辰巳第一PA（上り）
places.blurb: A small parking area with the Tokyo skyline behind the parked cars. A short second car-meet stop on the way back.
tips: Optional: Umihotaru island in the bay adds about 1 h and a ¥3,140 toll.

places.ja: 江島神社・片瀬江ノ島駅
places.blurb: Bocchi the Rock episode 9: the band's trip to Enoshima. Red torii, stone steps, tako-senbei at Asahi Honten, and the dragon-palace Katase-Enoshima station across the bridge.

info.label: Parking
info.value: Coin car park near Enoden Enoshima / Katase-Enoshima stations (about ¥1,000–1,500): not on the island, which is 15–20 min on foot from the Enoden

tips: Park near Enoden Enoshima Station, look at the island from the Benten bridge, then take the Enoden 2 stops to the Slam Dunk crossing and back. Skip the shrine climb: the island walk alone takes 1 h 30.
Pegasis marked Enoshima not interested: it is kept to about 1 hour.
Clear winter mornings show Mt Fuji across Sagami Bay.

places.ja: 大観山（アネスト岩田ターンパイク箱根）
places.blurb: The Hakone Turnpike (14 km of smooth curves from Odawara) ends here at 1,011 m, with Mt Fuji over Lake Ashi.
tips: Ice is most common before 10:00: you drive it at about noon.
Eat lunch at the Sky Lounge at the top.

places.ja: 乙女峠
places.blurb: The Route 138 pass between Sengokuhara and Gotemba, with a big Fuji view from the Fujimi-chaya side.
tips: Stop only in the marked lay-by, not on the road.

places.ja: 富士モータースポーツミュージアム
places.blurb: A museum at the gate of Fuji Speedway with about 100 years of race cars from Toyota, Nissan, Honda and others.
tips: 20 min by car to the Gotemba outlets.

places.ja: 御殿場プレミアム・アウトレット
places.blurb: A large outlet mall with Mt Fuji behind the shops. A plain shopping stop for Pegasis.
tips: Fuji view from the Hill Side bridge.
45 minutes only: you must be over Kagosaka Pass before dark.

places.ja: 河口湖 大石公園
places.blurb: Mt Fuji straight across the lake. At sunset the snow on Fuji turns pink.
tips: Very cold after sunset; wear the ski jacket.

places.ja: HANZ OUTDOOR RESORT 河口湖
places.blurb: The one special night: a Fuji-view villa south of Lake Kawaguchi. No restaurant: the dinner is a BBQ course grilled on your villa terrace (or a no-grill dining course), and breakfast is a skillet set cooked at the villa.

info.label: Address
info.value: 3283-1 Katsuyama, Fujikawaguchiko (official site; turn left at the Katsuyama crossing on Route 139)

info.label: Price
info.value: About CA$275 for 2 with breakfast; half board about +CA$126 (Expedia, Sep 25, 2026)

info.label: Check-in
info.value: 14:00; last check-in 17:00 on some sites, 19:00 on others: phone to say you arrive about 17:10

tips: Book half board: there is little food nearby in the evening.
Choose the no-grill seasonal dining course if you do not want to grill in the cold.

places.ja: 新倉山浅間公園 忠霊塔
places.blurb: The five-storey red pagoda with Mt Fuji behind it. At sunrise Fuji turns pink; 398 steps up to the viewing deck.

info.label: Parking
info.value: Small free car park at the foot of the steps

tips: Climb in the dark with a phone light; the steps can be icy: shoe spikes.
There is a gentle slope path next to the steps.

places.ja: 浩庵キャンプ場（本栖湖）
places.blurb: Yuru Camp episode 1: Rin's solo camp, where Nadeshiko sees Fuji. Also the Fuji view on the ¥1,000 note.

info.label: Price
info.value: Free to look; the campsite lists ¥600 per car (not clear for short visits): keep ¥600–1,000 cash

tips: Hold a ¥1,000 note up to the view.
Roads can be icy in the morning: drive slowly.

places.en: Toyota Rent a Car Mishima Shinkansen-guchi / Mishima Station
places.ja: トヨタレンタカー 三島新幹線口店
places.blurb: Drop the car here, 2 minutes from the Shinkansen (north) gate of Mishima Station, then take the Shinkansen west.

info.label: One-way
info.value: Accepted from other prefectures; Kawasaki Shinkawabashi → here ¥8,800

info.label: Train
info.value: Kodama 813 10:24 → Shizuoka, Hikari 707 → Nagoya, Nozomi 359 → Shin-Osaka 12:54 (Oct 2026 timetable)

tips: Fill the tank near the station first (満タン返し).
Buy an ekiben for the train.

places.ja: 天然温泉 夕霧の湯 ドーミーインPREMIUMなんば
places.blurb: Your one west base for 5 nights: Nara, Suzuka, Kyoto, Kobe and Liberty Walk are all day trips. Hot-spring bath and free late-night ramen.

info.label: Price
info.value: Not checked (Google Hotels ignored the dates); about ¥18,000–25,000 a night for a twin (estimate). Only 12 twins + 7 compact twins: book now on the official site

info.label: Free
info.value: Yonaki soba ramen 21:30–23:00, ice cream after bath (official site)

info.label: Laundry
info.value: Washers with automatic detergent; dryer ¥100 / 20 min (official site)

info.label: Access
info.value: 5 min from Nippombashi Station exit 6 / Nagahoribashi exit 7

The hot-spring bath is optional.

places.ja: 東大寺
places.blurb: The giant bronze Buddha in one of the largest wooden buildings in the world, with the Nara deer all around.
tips: Go in before 16:00.
Deer bite paper: keep maps and tickets in a pocket.

places.ja: 飛火野
places.blurb: A wide open field in Nara Park with a clear view of Wakakusa hill: fireworks at 18:15, the whole hill set on fire at 18:30.
tips: Cancelled in bad weather, with no second date.
Trains back are crowded: walk to Kintetsu-Nara by 19:15.

places.ja: 鈴鹿サーキット
places.blurb: The Japanese F1 track. In the park you drive an EV kart on the real East Course; no licence needed.

info.label: Jan 24 hours
info.value: 10:00–17:00 (official park calendar, checked Sep 26, 2026; open Jan 22–25 only)

info.label: EV kart
info.value: About ¥2,000 per kart, up to 3 people (Asoview, online only). Runs only about 12:00–13:15 in late January (Jan 24, 2026: 12:10–13:20); 2027 times come out on Dec 1, 2026

info.label: Access
info.value: Kintetsu Shiroko Station + Mie Kotsu bus, 20 min

tips: The park is closed Jan 26–29; Jan 24 is one of 4 open days.
Buy the kart slot on Asoview on Dec 1, 2026, for about 12:30.

places.en: Toyota Commemorative Museum of Industry and Technology

places.blurb: Toyota's first red-brick loom factory: looms, then cars built step by step with robot demos.
tips: Open on Sunday; Toyota Kaikan in Toyota City is closed on Sundays.

tips: Try tebasaki wings or a Taiwan ramen.

places.blurb: Thousands of red torii gates up the hill. At 7:00 the tunnels are almost empty.

tips: Walk to the Yotsutsuji viewpoint (about 40 min up) and back.

tips: Be at the gate at 9:00, before the tour buses.

info.value: 京都市役所前 / 三条

tips: Eat ramen here for the scene.

places.ja: 京都駅
places.blurb: The big station hall is the meeting place in Sabbat of the Witch. Optional snack at Kyoto Ramen Koji on the 10th floor.

info.label: Sabbat
info.value: The big meeting-place hall of the game

places.ja: スターバックスコーヒー 神戸北野異人館店
places.blurb: A Starbucks inside a 1907 Western-style house: café Schwarze Katze in Sabbat of the Witch.
tips: The inside was renovated, so it differs from the game CG.

places.ja: ステーキランド神戸館
places.blurb: A well-known low-cost teppanyaki steak house near Sannomiya: Kobe beef cooked in front of you.

info.label: Lunch
info.value: Kobe beef lunch sets are much cheaper than dinner (about ¥3,000–6,000, check)

tips: Aoki can order a normal steak or chicken set.

places.ja: 南京町
places.blurb: Kobe's small Chinatown: pork buns, dumplings and street food in two short streets. It stands in for the Yokohama Chinatown that did not fit in Tokyo.

info.label: From Sannomiya
info.value: JR 1 stop to Motomachi, 3 min walk

info.label: Best
info.value: Roushouki (老祥記) pork buns, queue moves fast

tips: Some stalls close on Mondays; Tuesday is fine.

places.ja: 神戸ポートタワー
places.blurb: The red tower on the harbour, reopened in 2024 with an open-air roof deck. Sunset and the Kobe night view.

info.label: Ticket
info.value: ¥1,200 with the roof deck (observation only ¥1,000), timed web ticket

tips: Chosen over Mt Maya: the Maya ropeway stops at 17:30 on winter weekdays and had long January inspection closures in past years.

places.ja: グランフロント大阪
places.blurb: The date mall in Sabbat of the Witch, next to Osaka Station. Pokémon Center Osaka and Nintendo OSAKA are 5 min away in Daimaru Umeda, 13F.

info.label: Nearby
info.value: Pokémon Center Osaka and Nintendo OSAKA: Daimaru Umeda 13F, 10:00–20:00 (osaka-info.jp)

tips: Go to Pokémon Center first (closes 20:00), then Grand Front (shops to 21:00).

places.ja: 黒門市場
places.blurb: A covered market street: grilled scallops, wagyu skewers, fruit and cooked seafood.
tips: Aoki: choose grilled and cooked stalls, not raw.

places.ja: 日本橋でんでんタウン・オタロード
places.blurb: Osaka's Akihabara: electronics on Sakaisuji and the side street Otaroad full of figure, game and doujin shops.
tips: Animate and Melonbooks are 2 min apart.

places.ja: めいどりーみん 大阪日本橋オタロード店
places.blurb: The Osaka shop of the same maid café chain, on Otaroad. A break between shops.
tips: For a quieter one, CCOちゃ opens 15:00 on weekdays.

places.ja: JDM PARK / LB DRIVE-IN
places.romaji: Jē Dī Emu Pāku / Eru Bī Doraibu In
places.blurb: Liberty Walk's wide-body cars, goods shop and a Sanuki udon shop, opened in 2025.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Official site 11:00–21:00 daily; Instagram 11:00–19:00, closed Thu

tips: Wednesday is open on both sources; do not go on Thursday.
Taxis at Izumi-Sunagawa are not certain: ask the shop to call one, or walk the 1.7 km (about 22 min).

places.ja: 戎橋
places.blurb: The Glico sign and the canal lights. Takoyaki and okonomiyaki all along Dotonbori.
tips: Busy until late; keep bags in front.

places.ja: 大阪国際空港（伊丹）
places.blurb: The city airport for domestic flights. Small and fast; JAL includes a 20 kg bag.

info.label: Flight
info.value: JAL (J-Air) 10:50 → New Chitose 12:35, Thu Jan 28, ¥16,330 incl. 20 kg bag (Google Flights, Sep 26, 2026)

info.label: Bus
info.value: Osaka Airport Limousine from Namba-ekimae (N1) 08:40 / 09:00 → Itami North Terminal (JAL) 09:10 / 09:30, ¥730; from OCAT (JR Namba) 08:50 / 09:10

tips: Bag drop closes 20 min before departure.

places.ja: 新千歳空港
places.blurb: Hokkaido's main airport. Rental car counters send a free shuttle to their lots.

info.label: Rental cars
info.value: Counters in arrivals, free shuttle to the shops

info.label: Tax-free
info.value: From Nov 2026 tax-free is a refund at departure: keep receipts and goods for the customs check

tips: Snow delays are common: keep phone numbers of the hotel and the car shop.

places.en: Toyota Rent a Car New Chitose Airport Poplar
places.ja: トヨタレンタカー 新千歳空港ポプラ店
places.blurb: Check in at the rental counter in the arrivals hall, then a free 9-min shuttle to the shop. Studless tyres are standard in Hokkaido.

info.label: Rent
info.value: Thu Jan 28 13:40 → Sun Jan 31 about 12:45, one way to Sapporo-ekimae

info.label: Car
info.value: Ask for 4WD (e.g. Corolla Cross / Yaris Cross 4WD)

info.label: One-way
info.value: Allowed inside Hokkaido; fee not checked (small, check when you book)

tips: Book now (6 months ahead): late-January 4WD cars sell out.
Give your flight number when you book: the shuttle needs it.
Skis fit inside a small SUV; the ski gear is rented at Hirafu anyway.

places.ja: ステイリゾートニセコ
places.blurb: A small self check-in hotel in Kutchan town, 5 min on foot from JR Kutchan Station. Every room has a mini kitchen; 15 min by car to Grand Hirafu, 50 min to Rusutsu.

info.label: Room
info.value: Twin (bunk bed) with bath and toilet, mini kitchen, non-smoking (the whole hotel is non-smoking)

info.label: Price
info.value: ¥81,360 per room for 3 nights, room only = ≈ ¥40,700 per person (Rakuten, Sep 26, 2026; 9 rooms left)

info.label: Address
info.value: Kita 1-jo Nishi 2-20-5, Kutchan (pin: nearest block point)

info.label: Parking
info.value: Free car park 200 m away (map at the front)

tips: Replaces Hotel Three M: on Sep 26, 2026 it had only smoking twins left for these nights.
No staff at night: phone numbers are at the check-in machine.
The twin has a bunk bed; the sister hotel STAY LIVING NISEKO (Kita 2-jo Nishi 1) has the same rooms and price.

places.ja: セイコーマート 倶知安
places.blurb: Hokkaido's own konbini, with a Hot Chef counter that cooks katsudon and fried chicken in the shop.
tips: Buy the next breakfast here too: the hotel has no breakfast, but the room has a mini kitchen.

places.en: Grand Hirafu .Base (rental shop and ski school desk)
places.ja: グラン・ヒラフ .Base（レンタル・スクール）
places.blurb: The official rental shop at the foot of the slopes. Rent everything here, including the ski jacket and pants, and leave it in the daily storage overnight.

info.label: Ski wear
info.value: Jacket + pants set ¥9,000 / 2 days ¥16,200; set with new goggles, gloves and beanie about ¥15,000 / ¥22,200

info.label: Full set, 2 days
info.value: Skis, boots, poles, wear with goggles/gloves/beanie, helmet: ¥42,900 per person, ≈ ¥38,600 with the 10% early code (official price tool, Sep 26, 2026)

tips: Reserve online before Oct 31, 2026 with code TGHRental109 (10% off, shown on en.grand-hirafu.jp/snow/rentals).
Daily storage: leave the gear at the shop between the two ski days.

places.ja: ニセコ東急 グラン・ヒラフ
places.blurb: The biggest Niseko slope, with light powder and Mt Yotei across the valley. Pegasis teaches Aoki on the beginner area on both days.

info.label: Lift ticket 2026–27 (Peak season, Dec 24 – Feb 28)
info.value: Hirafu & Hanazono 1 day ¥11,800 online (¥12,500 at the counter); afternoon 4 h ¥8,400 online (¥8,900) (official ticket page; online sales not open yet)

info.label: Beginner area
info.value: Ace Family area (Ace Family lift, own ticket counter at its base)

info.label: Lesson
info.value: None: Pegasis teaches Aoki (a paid group lesson is in Japanese only)

tips: Pegasis: stay on marked runs; the gates to the backcountry need avalanche gear.
Start Aoki on the flat part at the bottom of the Ace Family area: walking with skis, snowplough, stopping; ride the lift only after that.

places.ja: ルスツリゾート 雪上ドリフト
places.blurb: A closed snow course at Rusutsu with Subaru, GT-R and GR Yaris cars. You drive yourself with an instructor next to you.

info.label: Ride-along (pro drives, 4 min)
info.value: Subaru B4 ¥17,000 per person for 1–2 people; slots 8:30, 10:00, 13:00, 15:00

info.label: Booking
info.value: Prepaid, by 17:00 the day before; cancel fee 10% from booking, 50% the day before, 100% after 17:00 the day before

info.label: Reception
info.value: Rusutsu Resort activity desk (open 08:00–16:00), shuttle to the River Wood car park

tips: Email activity@rusutsu.co.jp before booking: the site asks only for a driver's licence and does not say if a 1-year licence + IDP is accepted.
Bring passport, licence and IDP; alcohol check before driving.

places.ja: スープカレー GARAKU
places.blurb: Sapporo's famous soup curry: a thin spicy soup with big chicken and grilled vegetables.
tips: Be in the queue by 11:20 on Sunday.
You arrive by car: use a coin car park near Nijo Market (no parking at the shop).

places.ja: トヨタレンタカー 札幌駅前店
places.blurb: Return the Hokkaido car here, 6 min on foot from JR Sapporo Station (east side, across Soseigawa-dori).
tips: Fill the tank before you return the car.

places.ja: ホテルルートイン札幌中央
places.blurb: A good-value business hotel with a public bath and free breakfast buffet, 5 min from Susukino and Daruma.

info.label: Laundry
info.value: Coin laundry in the hotel (Route Inn standard)

tips: Book the early-bird plan by about Jan 4.

places.ja: もいわ山
places.blurb: A ropeway and mini cable car to a viewpoint above the whole of Sapporo. Go up before sunset and stay for the lights.
tips: Free shuttle bus from the streetcar stop ロープウェイ入口.

places.ja: 成吉思汗だるま 本店
places.blurb: The most famous Jingisukan (grilled lamb) shop in Sapporo, since 1954: a small counter with dome pans.
tips: Cash is safest.
Your clothes will smell of lamb: wear the old jacket.

places.ja: 札幌駅
places.blurb: The JR hub. Limited expresses to Asahikawa and the Rapid Airport train to New Chitose leave from here.
tips: Coin lockers for big suitcases are in the station.

places.ja: ラーメンの蜂屋 五条創業店
places.blurb: Asahikawa shoyu ramen since 1947, with a pork-and-fish soup and burnt lard on top. 10 minutes on foot from the station.
tips: Ask for less burnt lard (少なめ) if you like.

places.ja: 旭山動物園
places.blurb: King penguins walk a 500 m loop through the snow between the visitors. Also polar bears and seals.

info.label: Bus
info.value: Asahikawa Denki Kido bus 41/47 from Asahikawa Station, about 40 min, ¥670 each way (from Sep 1, 2026); winter timetable not out yet

tips: Stand on the route by 10:45 for the 11:00 walk.

places.ja: SHO-RIN すすきの本店
places.blurb: A top-rated Susukino soup curry, 1 min from Susukino Station.
tips: Monday is open.

places.en: MEGA Don Quijote Sapporo Tanukikoji (24 h)
places.ja: MEGAドン・キホーテ 札幌狸小路本店
places.blurb: Last big shop before the flights: snacks, cosmetics and gifts, tax-free. Pegasis fills the suitcase here.

info.label: Tax-free
info.value: From ¥5,000 before tax, passport; refund at the airport from Nov 2026

info.label: Also
info.value: Luggage scale and a second small bag if the suitcase is full

tips: Weigh the suitcase: most checked bags must be 23 kg or less.

places.ja: ビックカメラ 札幌店
places.blurb: Last tax-free shopping next to Sapporo Station: electronics, cosmetics and snacks.
tips: Show the tourist coupon on your phone before you pay.

places.ja: 自家製麺 杵屋麦丸 成田国際空港第1ターミナル店
places.blurb: Self-service udon made in the shop, with tempura and rice balls. In the Terminal 1 Central Building, 5F, before security.
tips: Aoki eats here while he waits for Pegasis. Both flights use Terminal 1.
Other choice on T1 4F: Tonkatsu Saboten.

places.ja: 炭火串焼 かっぺ亭 新宿思い出横丁本店
places.blurb: A charcoal yakitori bar in Omoide Yokocho with 42 seats, so two people get in easily. Cheap skewers and drinks.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Mon–Fri 16:00–23:00, Sat/Sun 12:00–23:00, no closed day (Tabelog, Sep 2026; Omoide Yokocho site)

tips: Cash is safest (the Omoide site says cash only).

places.ja: 珉亭
places.blurb: An old Chinese diner famous for pink fried rice and "ra-chan" (ramen + fried rice). 2 minutes from SHELTER.
tips: Everything is cooked: good for Aoki.
60 seats: dinner takes 30–45 min.

places.ja: 魚べい 渋谷道玄坂店
places.blurb: Touch-screen sushi: plates come on an express lane. There are cooked plates too (fried chicken, egg, noodles).
tips: Aoki can order only cooked plates.

places.ja: アネスト岩田スカイラウンジ（大観山）
places.blurb: The food court and tea lounge at the top of the Hakone Turnpike, with Fuji over Lake Ashi. Ramen, soba and curry.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Food court about 09:00–16:30; 2F tea lounge weekdays 10:00–15:30

tips: No winter closing was found, but the 2027 menu is not confirmed.

places.en: Tochuken ekiben stand, Mishima Shinkansen platform
places.ja: 桃中軒 三島駅 新幹線ホーム売店
places.blurb: The local ekiben maker since 1891, with a stand on the Shinkansen platform. The Ashitaka beef sukiyaki bento is cooked, not raw.
tips: Buy it on the platform, eat it on the Kodama (3 h, no change).

places.ja: すき家 近鉄奈良駅前店
places.blurb: A fast beef-bowl chain shop next to Kintetsu-Nara Station. Quick and warm before the cold wait at the fire.
tips: Kamameshi Shizuka is not possible: last order 16:00 on Saturday.
Festival food stalls may also be open on the field.

places.ja: アドベンチャイナ（鈴鹿サーキットパーク）
places.blurb: The ramen shop in the park, in Adventure Village. Adventure Grill (burgers) and AdvenCurry are next to it.

info.label: Menu
info.value: Spicy miso ramen ¥1,250; tanmen ¥1,300; curry ¥1,500; burger ¥1,270 (official foods page)

tips: Which park restaurants open on Jan 22–25 is not published: check the foods page in January.

places.ja: 矢場とん 矢場町本店
places.blurb: The main shop of the Nagoya miso-katsu chain, next to Osu. The famous dish is the waraji (sandal-size) katsu.

info.label: Access
info.value: 10 min on foot from Osu; Meijo Line Yabacho 5 min

tips: Expect a queue on Sunday evening; bookings up to 4 people.

places.ja: 松屋 日本橋店
places.blurb: A 24-hour gyudon chain shop, 3 min from the hotel. Hot Japanese breakfast sets for about ¥500.
tips: Order at the ticket machine by the door.
The hotel buffet costs ¥2,500 per person: here it is one fifth.

places.ja: 名代とんかつ かつくら 三条本店
places.blurb: A well-known Kyoto tonkatsu shop on Sanjo-dori at the Sanjo Meitengai arcade. Free refills of rice, cabbage and miso soup.
tips: No bookings: expect a short queue at 12:40.

places.ja: 大衆酒場 ひとめぼれ 裏難波店
places.blurb: A cheap, busy izakaya in the Ura-Namba lanes, 8 min from the hotel. Skewers, fried food and cheap drinks.
tips: Backup in the same lanes: 路地裏酒場 とんぼ (Mon–Fri 15:00–24:00).

places.ja: 串かつ 松葉 総本店
places.blurb: A classic standing kushikatsu bar under the JR tracks in Umeda. Fried skewers from about ¥120 each.
tips: Cash only.
No double-dipping in the shared sauce.

places.ja: 美津の
places.blurb: An okonomiyaki shop on Dotonbori since 1945, cooked in front of you on the griddle.
tips: Write your name on the list, then see the Glico sign while you wait.

places.en: Shirakaba Sanso ramen, Hokkaido Ramen Dojo (New Chitose)
places.ja: 麺処 白樺山荘 新千歳空港店
places.blurb: Sapporo miso ramen in the Ramen Dojo, domestic terminal 3F, before security. Fast: 30 minutes is enough.
tips: Pin is the terminal point.

places.ja: 松尾ジンギスカン 新千歳空港店
places.blurb: Hokkaido grilled lamb in the domestic terminal 3F, before security; 5–10 min on foot from the international terminal.
tips: Pin is the terminal point.

places.ja: ラーメン店 なかま
places.blurb: A local ramen shop 2 min from the hotel, open late.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Mon, Thu, Fri, Sat 11:00–14:00 / 17:00–24:00; Sun 11:00–24:00; closed Tue, Wed (Tabelog)

tips: Closes early if the soup runs out.

places.ja: 望羊荘
places.blurb: An old family lodge on the lower Hirafu slopes with cheap katsu curry and ramen, much cheaper than the resort restaurants.
tips: 2026–27 hours not confirmed.

places.ja: POWDERHOOD RESTAURANT & TAPROOM（ALPEN NODE）
places.blurb: Burgers and hot food in ALPEN NODE at the Ace Gondola base plaza, 5 min from .Base.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Winter daytime from about 10:30 (two sources disagree on the closing time)

tips: Backup: the food court in the Hirafu Welcome Center.

places.ja: 居酒屋 餃子の肉村
places.blurb: A small local gyoza izakaya, 5 min from the hotel. House gyoza at local prices.
tips: Opens at 18:00.

days.title: Land in Tokyo, airport bus to Tokyo Station, first night in Shinjuku
days.titleJa: 成田 → 東京駅 → 新宿（伊勢丹・思い出横丁）
days.summary: Aoki lands first and waits at Narita Terminal 1; Pegasis lands at 16:30 and you travel together from there. The airport bus drops you at Tokyo Station for the Girls Band Cry dome, then you eat yakitori in Omoide Yokocho and buy the suitcase for the way home at Don Quijote.
alerts: Pegasis: at immigration ask for a paper landing stamp, not the face-scan gate (the car shop checks it on Jan 21).
TMG observatory is closed today (3rd Tuesday): it is on day 2.

Meet in the Terminal 1 arrivals lobby (Pegasis lands 16:30).
Girls Band Cry ep 1: Nina arrives under this dome, 10 min (Aoki's pick).
Half-price stickers on sushi and bento before the 20:00 close (Pegasis's pick): snacks for the room.
Dinner: yakitori and a beer, 1 h (Aoki's pick).
Pegasis: the suitcase for the way home (empty for now), heat packs, shoe spikes. Aoki: tourist coupon. One drink in Golden Gai after, if you still have energy.

notes: One plan for both: Aoki waits at Narita (about 3 h) instead of going ahead alone; the station dome and Omoide are his wants, Isetan and the airport bus are Pegasis's.
Pegasis brings his own thick winter clothes: nothing to buy for the cold.
Phone data: set up a Japan data eSIM before you fly (about CA$15–25 for 10–20 GB), or buy a tourist SIM at Narita.

Aoki: if Air China cannot be booked, China Southern 09:15 → 13:15 or Juneyao 08:25 → 12:00 keeps the same afternoon.

days.title: Anime day: Your Name stairs, Akihabara, Ikebukuro, Nakano, a live show in Shimokitazawa

alerts: Buy the SHELTER ticket online when the January list is out (loft-prj.co.jp, in December); note the OPEN time.
Book the Maidreamin table on the official site.

Your Name stairs, 15 min, quiet in the morning (Aoki's pick).
Free 45th-floor view; Mt Fuji on a clear morning (both of you wanted it).
10 floors of figures and cards; ZEST (Oshi no Ko) 3 min north.
Lunch with the stage show, 1 h (Pegasis's pick).
Animate main store, Surugaya, K-BOOKS, Lashinbang (used goods).
Mandarake and used goods, 1 h 10.
Bocchi places in the dark streets, 15 min.
Dinner: pink fried rice or ramen + fried rice set, 40 min.
Real live show, standing. Recent shows: OPEN 18:15–19:00, START 18:45–19:30.

days.title: Shibuya Sky, Nissan Crossing, Girls Band Cry in Kawasaki, then Daikoku by your own car
days.titleJa: 渋谷スカイ → 銀座 → 川崎 → 大黒PA → 辰巳PA
